Node ex:ship must conform to one or more shapes in [ sh:property [ sh:hasValue Literal("false" = False, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:path nltl:beamTheoryUsed ] ] , [ sh:property [ sh:hasValue Literal("true" = True, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:path nltl:beamTheoryUsed ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:message Literal("A single allowable shear stress in MPa is required when beam theory is used.") ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node gen:MPaQuantityShape ; sh:path nltl:allowableShearStress ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:message Literal("A single yield shear stress in MPa is required when beam theory is used.") ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node gen:MPaQuantityShape ; sh:path nltl:yieldShearStress ] ; sh:sparql [ sh:message Literal("For beam theory, yield shear stress must equal yield point divided by sqrt(3) within relative tolerance 1e-6 (absolute fallback 1e-12 MPa), and allowable shear stress must not exceed 0.9 times the calculated yield shear stress.") ; sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:yieldPoint ?yieldQuantity ;
                              nltl:yieldShearStress ?yieldShearQuantity ;
                              nltl:allowableShearStress ?allowableQuantity .
                        ?yieldQuantity qudt:numericValue ?yieldPoint .
                        ?yieldShearQuantity qudt:numericValue ?yieldShearStress .
                        ?allowableQuantity qudt:numericValue ?allowableShearStress .
                        BIND (?yieldPoint / 1.7320508075688772 AS ?expectedYieldShearStress)
                        BIND (
                            IF (
                                ABS(?expectedYieldShearStress) * 0.000001 > 0.000000000001,
                                ABS(?expectedYieldShearStress) * 0.000001,
                                0.000000000001
                            )
                            AS ?tolerance
                        )
                        FILTER (
                            ABS(?yieldShearStress - ?expectedYieldShearStress) > ?tolerance
                            ||
                            ?allowableShearStress > (0.9 * ?expectedYieldShearStress)
                        )
                    }
                ") ] ]
source_oracle_rationale: Beam-theory allowable shear exceeds 0.9 tau_y.

Node ex:ship must conform to one or more shapes in [ sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:boolean ; sh:hasValue Literal("true" = True, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path nltl:iceStrengtheningStatus ] ] , [ sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:boolean ; sh:hasValue Literal("false" = False, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path nltl:iceStrengtheningStatus ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ] ] ; sh:path nltl:classificationSocietyRequiredScantling ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ] ] ; sh:path nltl:regulationRequiredScantling ], [ sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:node [ sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ; sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:decimal ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path qudt:numericValue ] ] ; sh:path nltl:selectedDesignScantling ] ; sh:sparql [ rdf:type sh:SPARQLConstraint ; sh:message Literal("When the regulation-required scantling is less than the classification-society-required scantling, the selected design scantling must be at least the classification-society value.") ; sh:select Literal("
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this
WHERE {
    $this nltl:regulationRequiredScantling ?regulationQuantity ;
          nltl:classificationSocietyRequiredScantling ?classificationQuantity .
    ?regulationQuantity qudt:numericValue ?regulationValue .
    ?classificationQuantity qudt:numericValue ?classificationValue .
    FILTER(
        datatype(?regulationValue) = xsd:decimal &&
        datatype(?classificationValue) = xsd:decimal &&
        ?regulationValue < ?classificationValue
    )
    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        $this nltl:selectedDesignScantling ?selectedQuantity .
        ?selectedQuantity qudt:numericValue ?selectedValue .
        FILTER(
            datatype(?selectedValue) = xsd:decimal &&
            ?selectedValue >= ?classificationValue
        )
    }
}
") ] ]

sh:sparql [ sh:message Literal("Discontinuous projected area and static moment must equal 1.05 and 1.10 times their continuous-surface values within a relative tolerance of 1e-6 and an absolute fallback of 1e-12.") ; sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:iceAccretionLikely true ;
                              nltl:continuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?continuousAreaQuantity ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?discontinuousAreaQuantity ;
                              nltl:continuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?continuousMomentQuantity ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?discontinuousMomentQuantity .
                        ?continuousAreaQuantity qudt:numericValue ?continuousArea .
                        ?discontinuousAreaQuantity qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousArea .
                        ?continuousMomentQuantity qudt:numericValue ?continuousMoment .
                        ?discontinuousMomentQuantity qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousMoment .
                        BIND(
                            ?continuousArea * "1.05"^^xsd:decimal
                            AS ?expectedArea
                        )
                        BIND(
                            ?continuousMoment * "1.10"^^xsd:decimal
                            AS ?expectedMoment
                        )
                        BIND(
                            IF(
                                ABS(?expectedArea) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal >
                                    "0.000000000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                                ABS(?expectedArea) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                                "0.000000000001"^^xsd:decimal
                            )
                            AS ?areaTolerance
                        )
                        BIND(
                            IF(
                                ABS(?expectedMoment) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal >
                                    "0.000000000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                                ABS(?expectedMoment) * "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal,
                                "0.000000000001"^^xsd:decimal
                            )
                            AS ?momentTolerance
                        )
                        FILTER(
                            ABS(?discontinuousArea - ?expectedArea) > ?areaTolerance ||
                            ABS(?discontinuousMoment - ?expectedMoment) > ?momentTolerance
                        )
                    }
                ") ] ]

                        FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                            ?item nltl:hasIceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans ?means .
                            ?means a nltl:iceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans .
                        }
                    }
                ") ] ]
